title.zh: Sophon宣布拟于11月30日关闭主网，资产提取将于11月25日截止
title.en: Sophon宣布拟于11月30日关闭主网，资产提取将于11月25日截止

current_state.zh: Sophon published a wind-down timetable for its mainnet, setting a November 25, 2026 asset-withdrawal cutoff ahead of final shutdown on November 30, and warned that assets left on-chain after the deadline may become permanently inaccessible.
current_state.en: Sophon published a wind-down timetable for its mainnet, setting a November 25, 2026 asset-withdrawal cutoff ahead of final shutdown on November 30, and warned that assets left on-chain after the deadline may become permanently inaccessible.
